shared_elements: human or humanoid face/head with eyes, nose and mouth
justification: Both depict an anthropomorphic being, and A's winged figure has a profile head with eye, nose and mouth just as B is a frontal human head — but that is a near-universal correspondence. A is a densely incised, linear, full-length composite figure in profile with wings, elaborate patterned garment, raised arm holding an object and surrounding plant/rosette motifs; B is an isolated, blocky, frontal head in high relief with minimal schematic features and no attributes, companions or setting whatsoever.
